digest.component_or_area: LLM gate runs and usage logging
propositions: Gate runs do not durably record per-run tool-call counts or request counts, making it impossible to tune step budgets or diagnose loop vs breadth behavior without re-running instrumented gates
The usage_log module computes tool-call metrics in failure_usage() but discards them at write time via a fixed _FIELDS allowlist, persisting only token counters
Gate runs with no REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var set record nothing to disk, forcing operators to add instrumentation or re-run to answer basic cost questions
The success path never calls failure_usage() or equivalent, so successful runs have no tool-call shape recorded at all
Loop-vs-breadth signals are computed ephemerally in log lines and then lost, making the existing tuning advice in docs/llm-framework.md unactionable without re-running
